text: Good evening madam/sir, I am writing for my grandson he is 22 months only. Since evening he is having fever, I checked just now it is showing 38.7. My worry is he is not taking anything at all, not his milk, not water, not even juice which he normaly loves. My daughter tried with bottle, then sippy cup, then with spoon also, but he is turning his face and pushing away every time. Nothing is going inside I think since many hours, maybe from afternoon itself, I am not fully sure of exact time. His parents are both very tense and frankly I am also very much scared, in our time we would have just waited but I dont want to take any chance with small child. Kindly advise what we should do, whether we should come to hospital tonight itself or wait till morning. Sorry for long message. Thanking you.
